title: Transaction fees can be underestimated due to early return
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `IAccount.validateTransaction` method besides validation `is also used during the gas fee estimation`. This way the protocol should `preserve as many steps as possible both for valid and invalid transactions`. In turn, the `ClaveImplementation.validateTransaction` function has an early return for the gas fee estimation calls.
